text: 你掰开伯纳德的手，把他摔在地上，诺曼则照料西尔维娅。你准备迎接再次袭击，但伯纳德突然跳起来，以惊人的速度冲向河边。
“教授！”诺曼喊道，“西尔维娅——我想她死了！”
你检查她是否还有脉搏或呼吸。确实如此，她已经死了。你凝视着被杀害的研究生，听见袭击者跳进河里，再也没有浮出水面。
你把西尔维娅埋在沙丘间。你和诺曼在墓前说了几句话，随后沿北汉尼纳河匆忙离去。直到傍晚，你们都没有再说话。

en.title: Alone Against the Frost · 466
text: You break Bernard’s grip and throw him to the ground while Norman sees to Sylvia. You brace for a renewed attack, but instead, Bernard leaps to his feet and, with startling haste, dashes for the river.
You check for any signs of a pulse or breathing. It’s true. As you stare at one murdered graduate student, you hear her attacker throw himself into the river. He does not emerge.
You bury Sylvia among the sand dunes. After you and Norman say a few words over her grave, you hurry away along the North Hanninah River. Neither of you speaks again until evening.
